title: Eccentricity -> 0 (e = 1e-09) reduces to the concentric cone
derivation: With e = 0 the oblique cone is the right cone CONE-01: developed angle = sector angle 2*pi/sqrt(10), area = 30000*pi*sqrt(10); for small e the quantities are continuous (values from the mpmath tier at this e).  The relation compares the pattern with the cone_frustum pattern of the same radii and height.
